case.title: Save from Latest section; single entry in Saved and filled icon on all instances

steps.targetDescription: Scroll to the target article in Latest News
steps.locatorHint: section[aria-label='Latest News'] [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG')

steps.targetDescription: Tap bookmark icon on the target article in Latest News
steps.locatorHint: section[aria-label='Latest News'] [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark-icon']

steps.targetDescription: Saved state indicator on Latest card is visible
steps.locatorHint: section[aria-label='Latest News'] [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark-icon'][data-state='saved']

steps.targetDescription: Only one saved entry for the target title exists
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='saved-news-item']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG')

steps.targetDescription: Featured card for target article shows filled/saved icon
steps.locatorHint: section[aria-label='Featured'] [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark-icon'][data-state='saved']

steps.targetDescription: Unsave from one instance to cleanup
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark-icon'][data-state='saved']

steps.targetDescription: Icon returns to unsaved state on the card
steps.locatorHint: [data-testid='news-card']:has-text('Take the next step in your development at UKG') [data-testid='bookmark-icon']:not([data-state='saved'])
